_comment: Treatment arm of the base-prompt A/B. Identical to corpus-boros-mirror.json in every respect except the system prompt, which is notalk-strategy = notalk plus a 'How To Play Well' section. The control prompt is untouched, so this adds an arm rather than editing a frozen one. Each rule in the added section corresponds to a measured failure: passing 65.9% of offered plays, blocking 4x more often than attacking with an aggro deck, lands-only battlefields, one blocker assigned to two attackers, and 8.6% of decisions producing prose instead of a tool call.
